exposure: angle of progression of the fetal head
Angle of progression of the fetal head
cohort: Women with a singleton pregnancy of ≥ 37 weeks' gestation, in cephalic presentation requiring vacuum extraction
finding: Angle of progression of the fetal head is a predictive factor of failed vacuum extraction, especially among nulliparous women.
mod_finding: The study found that a lower angle of progression of the fetal head during vacuum extraction was predictive of failed vacuum delivery and a higher likelihood of requiring forceps delivery or cesarean section.
